task.title: Fix the confirmed T38 findings: poison-envelope mailbox wedge, unbounded identifier strings, discarded cursor signal and inaccurate docstring
task.description: Turn the RED tests from dispatch 001-T41-tests GREEN by fixing HL-N-001, BE-R-001 and HL-N-002, and correct the SEC-R-001 docstring. The tests are the contract: make them pass without weakening them.
task.scope: apps/cli runtime/commands and apps/relay validation. Do not modify any test file.

acceptance_criteria: HL-N-001 (major): a permanently unacceptable envelope no longer blocks delivery of legitimate envelopes in the same batch or in later batches. Permanent rejections (untrusted sender, malformed ciphertext, wrong recipient - retrying can never succeed) are isolated per envelope; transient failures (persistence error, relay unavailable) still leave the envelope queued, unacked and retriable, exactly as the specification requires.

The F-012 guarantees survive unchanged: an unpinned sender is still rejected with CONTACT_NOT_TRUSTED, is never accepted into history, and a batch containing only that envelope still acks nothing and mutates nothing.

BE-R-001 (minor): oversized envelope identifier strings - at minimum recipient_mailbox_id and envelope_id - are refused by validation with a bounded 4xx, not by the store with an HTTP 500. The green control tests must keep passing, so the bound may not be met by refusing everything.
HL-N-002 (minor): the poll result surfaces remaining work to the caller, derived from the relay's next_cursor signal that the F-009 fix added.

SEC-R-001 (minor): the docstring at apps/cli/src/commands/cli.ts is corrected. It currently claims nothing formerly rejected changed behaviour, but `send --text --json` moved from exit 2 to swallowing the flag as content. Document the actual rule; do not change the behaviour, which is standard GNU semantics and is test-pinned.
Every test added or repaired by 001-T41-tests passes, unmodified.
The full apps/cli suite, `pnpm test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `go -C apps/relay test -race -count=1 ./...` and the `-tags relayv2` variant all pass. No pre-existing test is weakened, skipped or deleted.

TEST-AUTHOR CONSTRAINT T41-N-001: inbound.test.ts:177 asserts full-store snapshot equality and acks() == [] for a batch containing only a poison envelope, which RULES OUT the 'quarantine locally and include in the ack set' design. The workable design is per-envelope acceptance, acking only what was accepted, and rethrowing the first rejection when nothing was accepted.

TEST-AUTHOR CONSTRAINT T41-N-002: cli.ts:304 returns the poll result verbatim to stdout, so any `rejected` collection becomes process output. Entries must carry only { envelopeId, code } - never envelope content, ciphertext, plaintext or sender-supplied strings beyond the identifier.

The specification is explicit that a decrypt or database commit failure must NOT be acked and must stay retriable. Isolating permanent rejections must not turn a transient failure into a discarded message.
